title: The Grunion Run, ix
logline: Ninth year. Maria's there. Gully introduces her to the dog first. Correctly.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. GULLY with the thermos and, beside him, MARIA — practical, a county-issue rain shell, holding the paper cups. BARNABY going straight to her. WOOD at the edge, pad.

balloons.text: He's got a limp starting. Left front.

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns, a young man with a thermos beside a practical woman in a rain shell holding paper cups, a gray-muzzled dog going straight to her, a young man with a pad at the edge, muddy watercolor
image.notes: Maria: county nurse. She notices the dog's limp first. That's her.

panels.composition: Wood, at the edge, drawing them: Gully and Maria, from behind, the thermos between them like the dog used to be.

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad showing a man and a woman from behind at a lantern-lit surf line with a thermos between them

panels.composition: Maria, crouched to the dog, checking the leg with two fingers. Professional. Gentle.

balloons.text: He's fine. He's six. Six is when it starts.

image.prompt: a woman in a rain shell crouched on a night beach checking a small dog's front leg with two professional fingers

panels.composition: Silent. The fish. The lanterns. Gully and Maria at the water. Wood and the dog at the edge. Two pairs. The pad closed.

image.prompt: silent wide night beach panel: a couple at the surf line among silver fish and lanterns, and apart from them a young man with a closed pad and a small dog, no words

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Maria arrives. 'Six is when it starts.' The strip draws two pairs.
